summary: Iter14 — ticket-engine market-family scan verification. Backend: 29/29 passed (21 new iter14 + 8 iter13 regression). GET /api/lion-tickets returns 23–26 tickets with legCount in [2..6] (observed distribution {2:16, 3:6, 4:4}), quality gates respected (prob>=58, odds>=1.12, edge>=1.0), group uniqueness per ticket, no 'totalOdds' key anywhere, singlesReturn==sum(leg.odds)±0.02, singlesMultiple==singlesReturn/legCount, parlay bounded by [max(leg), product(legs)], all kickoffs in the future, sorted by kickoff day. Newly-unlocked pick ids present: away_or_draw(5), home_or_draw(4), home_or_away(2), fts_away(3), fts_home(1); ht_* absent (correct per spec — probs rarely clear 58%). Groups seen: result(24), goals(22), btts(12), fh(4), fts(4); ht:0. Frontend /lion-tickets: 23 cards rendered, badges match legCount, lt-maths line matches leg odds, lt-parlay only shown when API returned parlay, new leg types render with readable names ('Lyon or Draw', 'Lyon to score first'). Add-to-slip of a ticket containing both a double-chance and a first-team-to-score leg: both legs land in Portfolio BET SLIP with LION TICKET badge, odds inputs are readonly (locked) at their original bookmaker price, Potential return = €35.20 = (1.57 + 1.95) × €10 stake = singles sum × stake (NOT a product).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: in test_quality_gates I had to widen edge-mismatch tolerance to 0.6 because the backend persists prob as rounded int but edge is computed with the unrounded float — this is cosmetic but means consumers that re-derive edge from the exposed prob/odds will see small drifts (observed max 0.3). Consider either exposing a fractional prob or rounding edge from the integer prob so the fields are internally consistent.
LionTicketsPage.jsx line 68 reads t.anchor.pick — if a future response ever omits 'anchor' this throws. Guard with t.anchor?.pick.
The current fetch of /api/lion-tickets has no error-state UI: on error it just shows the empty-state message, which could mask backend outages from the user.
seed_data_creation: None — relies on /tmp/rapid_books 12h cache per RapidAPI quota guidance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter14 regression is /app/backend/tests/test_lion_tickets_scan_iter14.py. Combine with test_lion_tickets_singles_iter13.py for full /api/lion-tickets coverage. Portfolio slip verification lives in LionTicketsPage.jsx add() -> addToSlip({locked:true}); the slip-odds-* inputs render with readonly set when leg.locked is true, so UI tests should check `getAttribute('readonly') != null` (empty string is truthy for readonly in HTML).
